items.preparation_and_observation: Human blastocyst hatching from zona pellucida; light micrograph; catalogue says about six days after fertilization and embryo size about 0.3 mm.
items.evidence_limits: Prepared static micrograph, not a time lapse, viability assay, proof of implantation, or general stage clock.

items.preparation_and_observation: Human term chorionic villus, H&E annotated micrograph; maternal blood outside villus, fetal capillary blood inside.
items.evidence_limits: Term section cannot represent first-week implantation or quantify transport flux; stain is not live color; no measured scale claimed.
